agent.name: Musician Booking Model Engineer
agent.profile: Владелец typed booking context, validation and canonical serialization.

tasks.message: Реализуй typed model MusicianBookingContext: artist/project, organizer/contact, venue, city/country, date/time, event type, capacity, fee/currency/payment terms, performance duration, technical/hospitality rider, travel/accommodation, promotion, deadlines, attachments, confidence, missing_fields and source provenance. Добавь canonical serialization and validation tests.

agent.name: Musician Booking Classifier Engineer
agent.profile: Владелец domain intent classification and safe routing.

tasks.message: Реализуй domain classifier для intents: new_concert_offer, venue_outreach_opportunity, availability_request, fee_or_budget_question, technical_rider_request, hospitality_or_travel_question, contract_or_legal_question, promotion_or_press_request, schedule_change, cancellation, ordinary_correspondence, clarification_required, ignore. Возвращай confidence/rationale; legal/fee/cancellation ambiguity эскалируй.

agent.name: Musician Booking Extraction Engineer
agent.profile: Владелец extraction of concert terms and explicit unknown/missing state.

tasks.message: Реализуй extraction layer from normalized InboundEvent into MusicianBookingContext. Не додумывай отсутствующие цены/даты/условия. Явно отмечай missing_fields. Нормализуй currency/date/time только при достаточных данных и сохраняй исходный текст/provenance reference. Добавь fixtures на venue offers, rider questions, fee questions and cancellations.

agent.name: Musician Communication Profile Engineer
agent.profile: Владелец Git-versioned musician booking profile loading, but not autonomous sending.

tasks.message: Реализуй loader для общего profiles/musician-booking/* и artist-specific profiles under artists/<artist-id>/. Добавь deterministic artist resolution: explicit project/artist id -> mailbox/thread mapping -> configured contact/project mapping -> content-based candidate suggestion only. При ambiguity route clarification_required, не создавай proposal. Сохраняй artist_id, profile version and exact Git commit in provenance. MVP DRAFT_ONLY не даёт autonomous send.

agent.name: Musician Sprint Proposal Engineer
agent.profile: Владелец mapping domain context to specialist sprint proposal roles and tasks.

tasks.message: Реализуй proposal builder для концертной работы с учётом выбранного artist profile. Specialist roles остаются общими, но задачи/ограничения должны учитывать preferred markets, exclusions, availability constraints, fee boundaries, rider/promotion data and authority rules конкретного артиста. Если artist не определён однозначно или критические данные отсутствуют — clarification_required. Proposal не активирует sprint напрямую.

agent.name: Musician Domain Integration Engineer
agent.profile: Владелец plugin registration into central coordinator without source-specific branching.

tasks.message: Подключи Musician Booking Domain Adapter к центральному coordinator как domain handler/plugin. Один и тот же смысл из Email и Telegram должен давать эквивалентный MusicianBookingContext. Source adapters остаются generic. Добавь project/domain resolution hook and no hardcoded artist identity.

agent.name: Musician Booking QA Engineer
agent.profile: Независимый QA domain parity, extraction accuracy, proposal roles and safety boundaries.

tasks.message: Проведи isolated qualification: минимум два artist profiles с разными booking rules; один и тот же тип запроса должен давать разные proposal constraints для разных artist_id; ambiguous artist -> clarification_required; explicit artist id wins over inference; Email/Telegram parity; venue/date/fee/rider/logistics extraction; missing data not fabricated; contract/fee/cancellation ambiguity escalates; ordinary correspondence no sprint; DRAFT_ONLY no autonomous send; no direct nginx-qa activation. Evidence must include exact artist profile Git provenance.
